Definition: probably from the base of G1096; a woman; specially, a wife:--wife, woman.
BiblicalUsage: gynḗ means wife, woman. In Matthew 1:20, the text says "fear not to take unto thee Mary thy wife." In Mark 5:25, the text says "And a certain woman."
TheologicalSignificance: I take gynḗ to mean that family is God's idea, and the bonds He builds there are meant to hold. That is why I keep this word in mind when I read those passages — it carries more than its size suggests.
RelatedEvents: The Birth of Jesus; Jesus Turns Water into Wine at Cana; The Birth of John the Baptist
